name: vinny-editor
description: Personal AI code editor PWA, backed by Qwen 3 via Ollama, with shared cross-device state.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @vinny-editor/shared && npm run build --workspace @vinny-editor/server && npm run build --workspace @vinny-editor/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @vinny-editor/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @vinny-editor/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @vinny-editor/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
